title: Input-head update
statement: Let $M$ be a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $s$ be a snapshot of $M$, and let $i_L,i_R,h_\ell,h_m,h_r$ be Boolean indicators, with $i_L$ and $i_R$ recording whether the cell is at the left and right input boundaries. If $s$ is halted, the updated head indicator is $h_m$. Otherwise, a rightward transition gives $h_\ell$ or, at the right boundary, $h_m$; a stationary transition gives $h_m$; and a leftward transition gives $h_r$ or, at the left boundary, $h_m$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet
